ownership: These tracked source snapshots have moved into this repository as ordinary vendored source. Future changes are made and reviewed here; the original clones and published snapshots remain unchanged. These are not submodules.
validation: Exact tracked file paths, Git blob identities, file types and executable modes verified before portability adjustments. No builds or tests run.

portability_adjustments.reason: Resolve build-revision watcher metadata from the containing Git repository/worktree instead of ../../.git; include current branch ref, packed refs and index.
Keep self-redeploy Git operations at repository root, but find and build the validated Fleet Cargo workspace under components/fleet or the standalone root.
Recognize a nested component/worktree as a Git checkout without requiring its own .git directory.

portability_audit.fleet_build_revision: Git metadata watcher resolves actual containing repository/worktree HEAD, current branch ref, packed refs and index.
portability_audit.fleet_self_redeploy: Git fetch/fast-forward stays at containing repository; Cargo builds from components/fleet when present, otherwise standalone root. This optional command was not executed and is not a combined Board rollout.
portability_audit.task_board: No source edits required. Nix source paths, lockfile/UI paths and compile-time fixtures resolve within the component. Run scripts/gate.sh from components/task-board (root wrappers should cd there).
portability_audit.ci: Fleet .github workflows retained under component as source; root CI needs explicit component working directory/pathfilters and is not activated by nested workflows.
portability_audit.licenses: Fleet LICENSE preserved. Task Board declares MIT in Cargo.toml but imported snapshot contains no standalone LICENSE; none invented.
portability_audit.fleet_nix_freshness: Git worktree discovery supports nested Fleet source. Set FLEET_REPO to components/fleet; existing runtime deployment configuration remains explicit.
portability_audit.fleet_target_directory: Retain default components/fleet/target for checkout-run binaries. Observer/reviewer role discovery currently derives loops/ from executable ancestry; a shared outer CARGO_TARGET_DIR would break that existing assumption.
portability_audit.static_validation: All198 imported paths/types/modes preserved;195 files retain exact original blobs; only3 Fleet portability files differ. Cargo manifests parsed and3 path dependency destinations checked. git diff --no-index --check emitted no whitespace diagnostics for all3 changes (exit1 reports differing files).
